mapper.select: SELECT t.id,t.module_instance_id,t.node_id,t.assignee_user_id,t.candidate_role,t.round_no,m.project_id,m.module_code FROM workflow_task t JOIN module_instance m ON m.id=t.module_instance_id WHERE m.finished=FALSE AND t.status='OPEN' AND t.node_id=m.current_node_id AND t.module_instance_id IN #{id}
SELECT project_id FROM module_instance WHERE id=#{moduleId}

SELECT m.project_id,m.module_code,m.current_round,b.created_by,n.node_id,a.expert_name_snapshot FROM module_instance m JOIN workflow_task t ON t.module_instance_id=m.id AND t.status='OPEN' AND t.node_id=m.current_node_id AND t.candidate_role='EXPERT' JOIN expert_review_batch b ON b.module_instance_id=m.id AND b.round_no=m.current_round JOIN expert_review_assignment a ON a.batch_id=b.id AND a.expert_user_id=#{userId} LEFT JOIN workflow_node_config n ON n.id=b.workflow_node_id WHERE m.id=#{moduleId} AND m.finished=FALSE AND a.valid=TRUE AND (b.workflow_node_id IS NULL OR n.id IS NULL OR REPLACE(REPLACE(n.node_id,'ExpertAssignTask','ExpertReviewTask'),'ExpertSummaryTask','ExpertReviewTask')=t.node_id) ORDER BY b.id DESC LIMIT 1
